Montaña CF and Thames Rovers drew 0-0. On expected goals it finished 0.00–0.62: Thames Rovers did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Montaña CF had 58% of the ball. Pass completion MON 84% (178/212), TRV 75% (112/149). Shots 0–5, on target 0–0.

Montaña CF started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 66': From minute 66 Montaña CF's share of the threat (shots, chance quality, passing and high regains) jumped from 15% to 64% in five minutes: the spell when the game tilted their way.

By the numbers: V. Ramos completed the most passes (27); R. Guerreiro hit the top speed (32.1 km/h); N. Xhaka covered the most ground (5.76 km, a 16.5 km per-90 pace); Z. Yilmaz won the most challenges (11).

recap.fan: Nobody could find the net at Castellana Arena, Madrid. Chances came and went at both ends, but the keepers had the final word. Montaña CF had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: Z. Yilmaz, with 26 completed passes and 11 tackles. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
